# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We currently provide security updates for the following versions:
| Version | Supported |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.\*.\* | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

If you discover a security vulnerability within this package, please send an e-mail to agr@agmedia.de. All security vulnerabilities will be promptly addressed.
